lines.t: Can I step into your will and never leave it?
If my strength is gone, can you carry me on?
If I take the leap, will you give me wings?
Lead me farther into that place where my will dies
And all I see is your face
I forget my flesh and all troubles melt away
In the light of your glory all else fades
I'll leave the world behind
Unshackle the chains that bind
Let your spirit take over my mind
I'll surrender all
And together we'll fly
Leading me farther into that place
Where my will dies
And all I see is your face
I took in my flesh and all troubles melt away
In the light of your glory all else fades
Oh, my treasure, capture my gaze
Cover me in your love and grace
Hide me in your strong embrace
You're who you are, lead me to that place
Bye-bye.
